name: lucenia-reign-pays-two-and-discards-a-chessman-command-as-the-cost
notes: Lucenia's Reign: '(2), Discard a Chessman Command card: target Chessman ally gets +1 LIFE, draw a card into memory'. The (2) was never paid, the discard happened as part of the effect (after the opponent had priority) and the phantasia was exhausted by the implicit REST.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Lucenia's Reign's '(2), Discard a Chessman Command card' cost: the (2) was never paid, the discard was done by the effect body (after the opponent had priority) and the phantasia was exhausted by the implicit REST. Fix: ActivatedAbilityCost queues the discard choice and the two reserve payments, the effect body only targets the Chessman ally, and the id is on the skipAutoRest list.
